definitions.explanation: The tools, devices, or items needed for a particular activity or purpose. Used for military equipment, outdoor gear, gaming equipment, and more.
The act of equipping or fitting out with necessary items or features. Often used as a suru-verb to mean 'to equip' or 'to be equipped with.'

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}の{装備|そうび}を{整|ととの}える。
{冬山|ふゆやま}には{十分|じゅうぶん}な{装備|そうび}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Adequate gear is necessary for winter mountains.

examples.japanese: {軽装備|けいそうび}で{出発|しゅっぱつ}したが、{天候|てんこう}が{急変|きゅうへん}して{大変|たいへん}な{思|おも}いをした。
examples.english: I set out with light equipment, but the weather changed suddenly and I had a terrible time.

examples.japanese: エアバッグを{装備|そうび}した{車|くるま}だ。
examples.english: It is a car equipped with airbags.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}のセキュリティシステムを{装備|そうび}している。
examples.english: It is equipped with the latest security system.

examples.japanese: {全|ぜん}モデルに{自動|じどう}ブレーキが{標準|ひょうじゅん}{装備|そうび}されることになった。
examples.english: Automatic braking will be standard equipment on all models.

notes:
USAGE:
As a noun (sense 1), {装備|そうび} refers to the gear or equipment itself. As a する verb (sense 2), it means to equip or outfit something. Both uses are very common.

In gaming contexts, {装備|そうび} is the standard word for equipping items (weapons, armor, accessories) on a character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {装備|そうび}を{整|ととの}える (prepare/arrange equipment)
- {装備|そうび}を{揃|そろ}える (assemble gear)
- {標準|ひょうじゅん}{装備|そうび} (standard equipment)
- {完全|かんぜん}{装備|そうび} (full gear)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{装備|そうび} (military equipment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {道具|どうぐ}: tools, implements (more general, everyday items)
- {設備|せつび}: facilities, installations (fixed/built-in equipment)
- {備品|びひん}: supplies, furnishings (office or institutional items)
